_comment: The skin of each style: a building piece role (data/places/buildings.json 'pieces', and the place-wide roles below) -> a dressing id in data/dressing.json. _base: a kit to fall back to for roles this one lacks. Place-wide roles: ruin_wall and ruin_rubble (on ruined lots), signpost and milestone (roads), camp (raider lots, beside each tent). Roles a kit cannot fill are skipped: the tiles alone still read as the building.
